verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Open WebUI natively supports MCP starting in v0.6.31 and that users can call tools exposed by their MCP server from the product. External tool servers are connected via Settings → Admin → Tool Servers, and independent community feedback lists MCP integration among its features. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of supported MCP transports and configuration depth, and hands-on corroboration of tool calls working in practice.
